evals.prompt: Create a modern skill card component for React/Next.js with Tailwind CSS showing skill title, percentage progress, status badge, and course recommendation button.
evals.expected_output: Component uses white surface (#FFFFFF), 16px border-radius, soft card shadow (0 4px 20px rgba(13,17,51,0.06)), Poppins typography, primary purple (#6E43FF) button, status badge with 999px radius, and Lucide icons.

assertions.name: uses_official_card_radius
assertions.description: Checks if card uses 16px border-radius (rounded-2xl or rounded-[16px])

assertions.name: uses_brand_purple
assertions.description: Checks if primary color #6E43FF is used for primary actions

assertions.name: uses_pill_radius_for_badges
assertions.description: Checks if status badge uses 999px radius (rounded-full)

assertions.name: uses_lucide_icons
assertions.description: Checks if icons are imported from lucide-react

evals.prompt: Audit the AppHeader component and globals.css to verify if navigation active states and theme color variables match Smartpath brand guidelines.
evals.expected_output: Verifies that active navigation links use #F3F0FF background tint and #6E43FF text, and that brand gradient includes all 4 stops (#6E43FF, #3D5AFE, #00B4DB, #00C48C).

assertions.name: active_nav_tint
assertions.description: Active link styling matches #F3F0FF background and #6E43FF text

assertions.name: brand_gradient_stops
assertions.description: Primary brand gradient includes 4 stops from purple to mint green
